requirement.evidence: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
requirement.note: Cap, annual CPI adjustment starting January 1 of year after enactment (2027, since approved Jan 2026), reporting mechanism, and refund from penalty are all stated in the text.

key_value.evidence: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
key_value.note: CPI adjustment is in subsection d.

effective_date.evidence: This act shall take effect on the first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment, except that the Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety shall be permitted to take anticipatory action necessary to effectuate the provisions of this act.
effective_date.note: With approval on January 20, 2026, the fourth month next following is May, so May 1, 2026 follows by a small computation. The document does not state the date outright.

status.evidence: This act shall take effect on the first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment
status.note: Effective May 1, 2026, which is before 2026-10-01, so in_force holds.

coverage.evidence: The requirements of subsection a. of this section shall not apply to: (1) a dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent;
coverage.note: The document exempts one- and two-family dwellings, so it covers buildings of three or more units. The card's min_units of 3 is a reasonable reading, but the exemption is by dwelling type, not a unit threshold. The licensee exemption is also not captured, and no construction or CO cutoffs exist.
